what: as-collected orientation matrices for the quartz PETS anchor
convention: orientation = R_z(omega).R_x(alpha).R_y(beta) @ (UB @ B_inv); B = Busing-Levy from PETS cell params + volume; angles active, degrees
note: geometry uses reciprocal_cell(cell @ orientation.T); orientation matrices are non-orthonormal (fold the ~1% measured-vs-ideal cell correction).
